repository.name: @webex/internal-plugin-ediscovery
repository.purpose: Internal Webex JS SDK plugin registered as webex.internal.ediscovery for first-party compliance clients. It creates, lists, reads, restarts, and deletes compliance reports on the eDiscovery service, reads the client config, posts the summary-download audit event, and pages report content and content containers by report UUID or remote report URL with an in-memory container cache. Payload transforms registered with webex-core encrypt report requests under a new KMS key before they are sent and decrypt report requests, activities, and containers on the way in, on behalf of each container's onBehalfOfUser, recording failures as error or warning properties instead of rejecting.

ediscovery-sdk.summary: Published npm package (internal plugin). main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js. Importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-encryption and @webex/internal-plugin-conversation and registers EDiscovery as internal plugin 'ediscovery' with src/config.js and seven payload predicates and transforms that join the module-level webex config. Exports are the default EDiscovery class and the named ReportRequest, EdiscoveryError, InvalidEmailAddressError, and config (which resolves to undefined). The plugin API on webex.internal.ediscovery is createReport, getReport, getReports, deleteReport, restartReport, getContent, getContentContainer, getContentContainerByContainerId, getClientConfig, postAuditLog, clearCache, and the contentContainerCache session property. Per-method behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

ediscovery-service-api.source: eDiscovery service (reached as service name 'ediscovery' through the services catalog, or by a caller-supplied report URL; route definitions are not in this repository)
ediscovery-service-api.summary: POST reports with the encrypted report request; GET reports (qs offset, size); GET, PUT, DELETE reports/<id>; GET reports/clientconfig; POST reports/<id>/audit/summary-download; GET <report>/contents and <report>/contents/container (qs offset, size); GET <report>/contents/container/<id>. Error code 14400001 carries a JSON array of unknown emails in body.message.

kms-keys.source: KMS reached through @webex/internal-plugin-encryption (no module spec; code consulted: packages/@webex/internal-plugin-encryption/src/encryption.js and src/kms.js)
kms-keys.summary: kms.createUnboundKeys({count: 1}) and kms.createResource({userIds, keys}) for report requests; encryptText(key, text); decryptText(keyUri, ciphertext, {onBehalfOf}) and decryptScr(keyUri, scr, {onBehalfOf}) for reports, activities, and containers. Failures with statusCode 429, 502, 503, or 504 are retried by src/retry.js.

webex-core-plugin-host.source: @webex/webex-core (workspace package; module specs consulted: packages/@webex/webex-core/src/docs/README.md and src/interceptors/docs/README.md)
webex-core-plugin-host.summary: EDiscovery extends WebexPlugin in namespace EDiscovery, so this.config is webex.config.ediscovery; registerInternalPlugin merges the config and concatenates the payloadTransformer predicates and transforms into the module-level default config; webex.transform runs every matched predicate's transform with only the extracted object, and the payload-transformer interceptor applies outbound transforms to request options and inbound transforms to responses and error reasons.

webex-core-storage.summary: @waitForValue('@') makes each decorated request method return a promise that runs after the plugin store loads.

webex-common-utilities.summary: oneFlight with keyFactory on getContent, getContentContainer, and getContentContainerByContainerId; Exception as the base of EdiscoveryError, whose message comes from the first constructor argument.
